findings.recommendation: Add `require(globals_ != address(0), "zero address");` or use a custom error for gas efficiency.

findings.title: Rounding direction not explicit in share conversion
findings.description: The share conversion calculation does not explicitly handle rounding direction. In vault/share systems, rounding should favor the protocol (round down for deposits/mints, round up for withdrawals/redeems) to prevent value extraction through rounding.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit rounding: `Math.mulDiv(a, b, c)` for round-down and `Math.mulDiv(a, b, c) + (a * b % c > 0 ? 1 : 0)` for round-up, or use a library with mulDivUp/mulDivDown.
